text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Argh! What an unexpected twist of
fate...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it wasn't your fault, Trainer! Don't
worry
about it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But still, how could this have
happened?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I must seek the truth from Shiraoki!
Woiya, haiya!
